author: blu
body: To stat-mean gives the arithmetic mean of a list of integers. To stat-median gives the median value of a list of integers. To stat-mode gives the most frequently occurring value in a list of integers. To stat-variance gives the sample variance of a list of integers. To stat-std-dev gives the integer square root of the variance. To stat-range gives the difference between the maximum and minimum values. To stat-min-val gives the smallest value in a list. To stat-max-val gives the largest value in a list. To stat-percentile gives the value at the given percentile rank in a sorted list. To stat-histogram gives a list of bin counts for the given number of bins. To stat-correlation gives the Pearson correlation between two lists, scaled by 1000. To stat-sum gives the total of all elements in a list. To stat-count-where gives the number of elements falling between the given lower and upper bounds.
